snippet.title: Global Rescue | Official Announcement Teaser
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2873660/

Build your own base in Global Rescue and take command of firefighting, police, EMS, and SWAT operations — either in your hometown or any city around the world! Manage your fleet, hire staff, and take on a variety of authentic operations. Are you ready for your shift?
